thread:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — product wants a token-cost + unit-econ dashboard prototype. Key metrics: cost per 1k tokens, cache savings, batching delta, and per-route model costs. Need inputs from runtime + infra for accurate unit costs.
Devin Patel: +1. Platform will need a telemetry contract (ingest shapes) and a sampling plan. Do we want per-request KV cache hit/miss counts emitted?
Sanjay Rao: We can surface KV cache hits, batch size histograms, and GPU token-timings. Important: include model variant and seq_len bucket.
Clare O'Neill: UX asks — product wants an initial Console card that shows overall $/1k, and a drilled view for model/route/cache/batch. Wireframes incoming. Can someone confirm what labels to use for "route" vs "endpoint"?
Aisha Gomez: For rollouts UX: we need to show canary vs baseline unit cost delta and a confidence band. Also require a toggle to normalize by median seq_len.
Ryan Wu: From infra: we can emit per-shard cost estimates, but per-request cost will be estimated from token-time * perf profile. We should include a "cost_model_version" field in telemetry.
ingest-bot: Schema registered: metrics.v2.token_cost_estimate. See /internal/telemetry/schemas/metrics.v2.json
Mia Chen: Nice, can we paste the minimal telemetry snippet here so eng teams align?
Devin Patel: Sure — prototype schema (minimal):
```json
{
  "event": "token_cost_estimate",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "request_id": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "route": "string",
  "tokens_input": "int",
  "tokens_output": "int",
  "seq_len_bucket": "string",
  "kv_cache_hits": "int",
  "batch_size": "int",
  "gpu_ms": "float",
  "estimated_cost_micros": "int",
  "cost_model_version": "string"
}
```
Sanjay Rao: Suggest adding `cache_saved_tokens` and `was_cache_used: bool` to help compute true cache savings. Also `batching_window_ms` to understand batching tradeoffs.
Clare O'Neill: UX note — in Console we'll show two numbers: "raw cost" (sum estimated_cost) and "effective cost" (after cache savings). Need both event fields to compute.
Aisha Gomez: For rollout calculations, add `deployment_tag` and `canary_assignment` so product can slice by rollout cohort.
Devin Patel: Agree. Platform will accept the schema but we need a lightweight ingest flag for high-volume customers to sample 1% of requests. Will add `sample_rate` metadata.
Ryan Wu: Implementation plan: runtime emits full events for Dedicated/private (no sampling), hosted defaults to sample 5% and platform side will roll up to 1k-token-buckets. We'll publish a mapping doc.
Mia Chen: Ownership check — Sanjay owns runtime emits + seq_len buckets, Devin owns ingest pipeline + rollup jobs, Clare owns Console UI mocks & calculations, Aisha owns rollout UX and gating. Ryan will provide cost_model_version mapping.
Sanjay Rao: I'll drop a PR to runtime this week with the event name and enum for seq_len buckets.
Devin Patel: I'll add a protobuf contract and a quick ingestion validator. Can we get a test harness with ~1k synthetic events to validate rollups?
Clare O'Neill: I'll post wireframes by EOD Thursday. Expect simple card + expand for breakdowns. Will include canary delta visualization.
Aisha Gomez: I'll define the rollout slice semantics and how we label cohorts in the telemetry.
ingest-bot: Ingest pipeline: draft proto uploaded to //internal/telemetry/protos/metrics/v2/token_cost.proto (deployed to staging).
Mia Chen: Great. Next sync: Thurs 10:00 AM. Agenda: finalize proto, sampling rules, wireframes, and deployment timeline. Please add blockers here.
Devin Patel: Blocker: need mapping from GPU-ms -> $/micros for each machine type. Ryan?
Ryan Wu: I'll export current per-gpu cost table and attach to the proto PR by Wed.
Mia Chen: Thanks all. If anyone diverges from the schema, ping here before shipping. :thumbsup:
